text: {"rules":[{"id":"OSTEO-SCREEN-F-65PLUS","version":"January 2025","title":"Osteoporosis screening to prevent fractures: women 65 years or older","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in women 65 years or older.","grade":"B","effective_date":"January 2025","action":"Screen for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in women aged 65 years or older.","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"sex\": {\"is\": \"F\"}, \"quote\": \"women\"}, {\"age\": {\"min\": 65, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"65 years or older\"}], \"quote\": \"women 65 years or older\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"osteoporosis_screening\", \"window\": [\"{MY-99}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"screening for osteoporosis\", \"note\": \"Section text does not name the screening test (defers to Practice Considerations) or state a screening interval.\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text states no screening interval, so any recorded osteoporosis screening is counted; 99-year lookback used as an effectively unbounded window\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concept 'osteoporosis_screening' introduced (not in vocabulary): the section says 'screening for osteoporosis' without naming the test; the specific tests are deferred to the 'Practice Considerations' section, which is not included here. dxa_scan is a likely member but was not assumed.","No screening interval or rescreening logic is stated in this section; the numerator window is derived (any recorded screening) and requires human review.","The '*' after the date 'January 2025 *' refers to a footnote not present in the section text; its meaning is not represented.","No exclusions (e.g., existing osteoporosis diagnosis, current osteoporosis treatment, prior fracture) are stated in this section, so none were encoded.","Practice Considerations content (screening test choice, risk assessment details) is referenced but not included and is not represented."]}
